rationale: The bullish thesis has structurally failed: price never posted a positive tick from entry (MFE = 0%), broke below the consolidation base ($18.81–$18.98), and is now trading below the 9-EMA ($18.86) with the last two candles printing lower lows on rising volume — a clear distribution signature. At $18.79 we are only $0.10 above the invalidation stop ($18.69), and with momentum pointing lower it is more capital-efficient to exit now near $18.79 than to risk the full stop loss; the daily loss budget is already stressed, and there is no new catalyst or technical development to justify holding through the deteriorating price action.
